releases.name: Delivery Twin 2026-11-14
releases.body: Added Driver Chat, which runs on its own backend and now shares the twin chat with Field Twin. Field Twin wording was removed from the app. Dropoff places now have kinds, the companion is hidden, and there is a new Delivery Twin app icon.

jobs.description: A phone friendly field log with a map, receipts, and mileage, now with a food spots layer.

releases.name: Field Twin 2026-11-14
releases.body: Field Chat now runs on its own twin chat, apart from Cat Command Chat.

jobs.description: A field log with a map, receipts, mileage, and an Android app that tracks stops.

releases.name: raineurysm 2026-11-14
releases.body: Added a music machine mode beside simple mode, with troughs, funnels, faucets, sprinklers, dripping vessels, a lane pattern editor, a weather song, thunder, recording, and undo. Added a puzzle mode with five color mixing levels where vessels pour one blended flavor of water. Tapping a goal jar now dumps it out, and a new version prompt keeps an open tab from running old code.

jobs.description: A rain music toy where falling rain hits vessels that play notes.

releases.name: Sky Flow 2026-11-14
releases.body: Sky Flow 2.1 added three trucks in Free build.

releases.name: Sky Flow 2026-11-13
releases.body: Sky Flow 2.0 added containers, weld joints, and Turn and Flip in Free build.

jobs.description: A tower crane game where you stack crates as high as they will stand before the clock runs out.
An index page that lists every app with its age, phone tags, and notes.

releases.name: Score Hub 2026-11-14
releases.body: Registered MobbyHill on the score hub. Its scores count checkpoints first and the time to reach them second, and the hub now shows those as flags and a clock time.

jobs.description: A shared score service and hub page for the games

releases.name: Agent Test Bed 2026-11-15
releases.body: The agent turn was played and merged into the city.

releases.name: Agent Test Bed 2026-11-14
releases.body: The agent, steward, and grok turns for the day were played and merged into the city. The viewer now builds labels only near the camera so phones stop running out of memory.

jobs.description: A shared city that AI agents build one turn at a time

releases.name: MobbyHill 2026-11-14
releases.body: Created MobbyHill, a wireframe off road hill climb game with a driver seat view and phone tilt lean. Added a run clock, flag splits, and high scores on the score hub.

jobs.description: A wireframe off road hill climb for the phone with tilt steering and score hub scores.
